title: Explorations v1
description: The payloads of the browser routes behind the `explorations` capability in api/connection (ADR 0036 A8). Served since slice 7: GET api/expand-menu (ExpandMenu), one element's Expand entries and the pieces they add. Since slice 8: GET api/exploration (Exploration: a link's list, or the presented one), POST api/reader-exploration (ReaderExplorationReport), the opted-in presentation stamp (ExplorationStamp) and get_presentation_context's ExplorationReport (P35–P37). The envelope schema and every existing payload stay frozen. Contract notes: docs/wayfinder/diagram-normalisation/browser-contract-draft.md.
$comment: Caps (A13) are named in $defs/Limits with ticket 13's measured values (docs/wayfinder/diagram-normalisation/slice6-prototype.md); maxExpansions and maxExpandParamChars are provisional until ticket 11b. Each response echoes the caps it applied. Every capped list carries `total` before the cap and `truncated`. The service's types are ts/src/expand/menu.ts; the shared constants and the provisional expand codec are shared/explorations.mts.

ViewId.description: A view id (ADR 0012), as the envelope schema defines it: a stable ID or <note path>#<name>.

LocalId.description: An id inside one view: an element id (project-wide, ADR 0036 §2), or an edge, message or group id (local to its view, A10).

Family.description: The model family of a view (project-model/merge.ts FAMILIES, plus the two that add nothing to the model).

Direction.description: How a wire reads (A4). On an AttachWire: as written in its source. On a NeighbourEntry: from the element's side, forward = element → neighbour, reverse = neighbour → element.

Limits.description: The caps the service applied (A13; ticket 13), enforced the same way by service and page.

maxAddedSources.description: Distinct sources on one canvas; a source counts once however many of its elements are expanded (O7).

maxAddedBoxes.description: Boxes added by frames; the base view's own boxes do not count (O4).

maxAddedWires.description: Wires added by frames, attach wires included: two per added box.

maxMenuCandidates.description: Entries per section of one menu (diagrams; neighbours), after removing what is on the canvas.

maxRelationshipsPerElement.description: Model relationships read for one element's neighbours.

maxPieceBoxes.description: Boxes in one piece. A piece over it is cut and marked truncated; the frame's link opens the full diagram.

maxResponseBytes.description: The JSON body before compression. Past it, pieces are omitted (omitted: bytes) from the last entry backwards, neighbours first.

maxExpansions.description: PROVISIONAL (ticket 11b): (element, source) entries in one expand list.

maxExpandParamChars.description: PROVISIONAL (ticket 11b): length of the encoded expand query parameter.

PartKey.description: Identity of a box or wire on a grown canvas (A10): (source view, revision, kind, local id). Inside a Piece or Frame the view and revision are the piece's own and are not repeated per part; this full form is used where a part is named outside its piece (attach wires, the reader's report).

Expansion.description: One (element, source) entry, as present_diagram's expand takes it (§14) and the ?expand= link replays it, in order. P41: with `neighbour`, only that neighbour of element and its link in source (a "neighbour not drawn here" entry); without it, everything source draws around element.

Reading.description: One reading of a conflicting element (A3): a kind and/or a parent, with the views that give it. One reading is the usual case.

conflicting.description: More than one kind or parent reading (§4). The menu then lists one diagram entry per reading.

CommentPin.description: Fan-out (ticket 14): the open threads anchored to a part of a piece or frame, as counts only. A thread is read through the existing GET api/comments?target=view:<source> when the person opens the pin. Present only where the source view's feedback settings show comments (A9).

latestPostAt.description: An RFC 3339 date-time, as comment-activity spells it.

AttachWire.description: A wire from a piece's box to a box already on the canvas (the expanded element, or an element already drawn: O6, drawn once). Keeps its source's own id and ends as written (A10).

key.description: The wire's id in its source.

Piece.description: The part of a source that touches the element (§12): the element's inside when the source opens it, else its direct neighbours there. `model` is a cut of the source's last-good model in its own notation (O3), valid against the frozen envelope schema's DiagramModel, drawn full: every kept box has no frame (ticket 10, answer 9). It holds no box already on the canvas (O6) and no wire that leaves the piece (those are `attach`).

touches.description: The element the piece was cut for; its box is on the canvas.

opens.description: True when the source opens the element (the piece is its inside).

truncated.description: Cut at maxPieceBoxes; the frame's link opens the full diagram.

kind.description: The source's view kind, so the page can wrap the cut as an envelope to draw it.

Omitted.description: Why an entry carries no piece. `own`: the source is not a graph family (O3), offered as "open it on its own". `limit`: adding it would pass maxAddedSources or maxAddedBoxes (§13), offered as "open it on its own". `bytes`: dropped to stay under maxResponseBytes; a hover on it reads GET api/exploration for that one entry (the only case a hover costs a request).

DiagramEntry.description: A diagram that opens or draws the element (§11): opensIn first, then drawnIn, then the sources that open on their own (omitted: own), each by view id.

reading.description: Index into element.readings: one entry per (source, reading) on a conflict.

proposed.description: From a proposed view, through the occurrence index (A5); labelled "proposed".

adds.description: The count the menu shows: what this entry would add, after the cap.

onCanvas.description: The source already has a frame here; choosing the entry grows that frame (O7).

NeighbourEntry.description: A model relationship the canvas does not draw (§11), added inside a frame named for `via`, the diagram that draws that link (the first by name precedence, §3).

alsoDrawnIn.description: Other views that draw the same pair.

adds.description: The count the menu shows: what this entry would add, after the cap.

onCanvas.description: `via` already has a frame here; adding grows it (O7).

ExpandMenu.description: GET api/expand-menu?viewId=<base>&element=<id>&expand=<canvas>. One element's Expand entries, each with the piece it would add, so a hover preview and an add cost no request. "Inside" is not here: the page resolves it from the base envelope's own nesting (ADR 0029), so it works on plain groups too. An id that is not a model element (a plain subgraph, an unkinded node) answers 200 with element null and empty lists, never an error, so a right-click on it is not a failed request (G3).

revision.description: The base view's last-good revision the menu was cut against.

modelGeneration.description: ProjectState's model generation (moves on every rebuild, A1).

canvas.description: The expansions the request named that hold on this canvas, in order; entries already on the canvas are not offered again.

bytesTruncated.description: Some pieces were omitted (omitted: bytes) to stay under maxResponseBytes.

DropReason.description: Why a requested expansion is not on the canvas. A link or the page's own exploration is resolved best-effort and says what it dropped.

piece.description: P35: the piece this entry added when it was replayed, as the menu carries it, so the page builds the canvas from the same pieces as an add.

Frame.description: One source on the canvas (O7: one frame per source, grown by each element expanded from it). Placed beside the elements it touches (§13); layout is the page's. P35: its parts are the pieces of its added entries (`expansions.items[].piece`), not a second union model.

sourceRevision.description: A8: each source's revision, outside every envelope.

touches.description: The canvas elements this frame was expanded from, in order.

Exploration.description: GET api/exploration?viewId=<base>&expand=<encoded> (a link or the page's own), or GET api/exploration?viewId=<base>&presentationId=<id> (the agent's presentation). Every frame in one read, whatever the number of sources (ticket 14, cold load).

origin.description: `link` covers a page's own exploration too: both are a list the page sent.

generation.description: A8. For a presentation: moves on every present and on every frame refresh after a source recompiles or leaves (A11). Absent for a link.

expansions.description: Every requested entry in replay order, added or dropped with its reason.

notices.description: One line per change the page should say ("Runtime was removed, so its frame is gone").

pinsTruncated.description: P43: some open comment pins were left out so the answer stays within limits.maxResponseBytes. Entries and frames never are: the replay keeps those within the budget, and an entry that does not fit is dropped as limit_passed.

ExplorationStamp.description: What an opted-in bootstrap (api/bootstrap?explorations=1) and presentation event (api/events?explorations=1) add as `presentation.exploration` when the presentation has expansions; never sent to a page that did not opt in (A8). The page reads the frames with one GET api/exploration?viewId=<base>&presentationId=<id>.

parts.description: Boxes added, for the MCP-App line "N parts added: open in Archer" (A11).

ReaderExplorationReport.description: POST api/reader-exploration, only if O1 stands (a page's own expansions are reported to the agent like a reader's selection, the last page to speak). Same origin and body cap as POST api/walkthrough-position; 204 or 422. Transient reader state, like a selection: not an operation (ADR 0016), and never changes what another page shows. Frame selections ride here as (source, kind, id), since SelectionContext carries base-view parts only (A10). Rejected (422) unless `revision` is the base's current one.

expand.description: At most limits.maxExpansions; empty clears it.

selection.description: P36: frame parts the reader selected, as (source, kind, id); the service resolves them against the source's model (A10).

ErrorBody.description: ADR 0002's error shape, as http.ts error() writes it. An unauthorized or revoked caller gets the bare 404 every route gives, never this body (ADR 0015, A9).

DiagramList.description: Capped at maxMenuCandidates (shared with neighbours). `total` is the count before the cap; `truncated` is total > items.length (A13).

NeighbourList.description: Capped at maxRelationshipsPerElement and maxMenuCandidates. Same total/truncated rule.

ExpansionList.description: Capped at maxExpansions. Same total/truncated rule.

ExplorationReport.description: get_presentation_context's `exploration` (management socket getContext; ADR 0036 §14, O1, A10): the later of the agent's presented exploration and the reader's own report. Not a browser payload.
